o.name: adTribune Smart LED SF
o.desc:
Benefits of the AdTribune Smart LED Promotional Counter: The AdTribune Smart LED promotional counter allows you to set up a promotional stand and present your products or services. Discover why it's worth investing in the Smart LED promotional counter: Effective Advertising Display Your company graphics will be printed on the textile fabric that tops the promotional counter. We use sublimation printing, ensuring high-quality prints and excellent color reproduction. As a result, your promotional message will be clearly visible and will fit well with your brand's visual identity. To make the product even more attention-grabbing, the counter's frame is equipped with LED lights. These lights will illuminate the graphics effectively, making the entire stand more visible. This enhanced visibility will attract more attention from your audience, boosting the effectiveness of your promotional activities. Replaceable Prints If you change your promotional concept or prepare new seasonal graphics, you can simply order new prints from us. Our products are standardized, so the new print will fit the existing structure. This means the AdTribune Smart LED counter will serve you well for a long time across various promotional activities. Quick, Tool-Free Assembly You don't need any tools to assemble the counter's structure. The frame components are connected using special connectors. This makes it easy to set up the counter, whether you are heading to a trade show or an off-site promotion, without worrying about carrying a toolbox. Additionally, the edges of the textile prints are trimmed with silicone strips. To attach the graphics to the frame, simply insert the silicone strips into the slots on the frame. It's a simple and intuitive task that can be done quickly. What's Included in the Set?
Counter structure with a countertop
Printed graphics

o.name: adWall Vario Classic 220 singlesided
o.desc:
Where and when can you use the adWall Vario Classic wall? Logo walls of this type are versatile products. They are used during many different promotional actions and are mainly applied indoors. Here are a few suggestions on how to use the walls in your business.
Trade shows and promotions: The adWall Vario Classic is a great choice if you're preparing for trade shows or promotions in a shopping mall. The logo wall will accentuate your stand, mark its boundaries, and most importantly, draw the attention of passersby.
Offices and service locations: Our product can be displayed in places visited by your customers, such as waiting areas, corridors, or reception areas.
Cultural institutions and offices: A logo wall can inform visitors about current special events, grants, or cultural events.
adWall Vario Classic – what are the benefits of using this product? A logo wall is a very popular marketing tool. It helps you attract the attention of potential customers and better promote your products and services. Here are the benefits of adWall Vario Classic. Impressive shape and enhanced advertising message The product presented here is a curved wall. Its distinctive shape, guided by a vertical curve, makes the structure better capture the audience's attention compared to other exhibition systems. By using our wall, you will enhance your promotional message, making the advertisement more effective and easier to reach customers. High-quality print on washable material At adsystem, we ensure that our walls are truly impressive showcases for your company. That's why we prepare the print with your personalized graphics using sublimation printing. This ecological technique is not only environmentally friendly but also ensures vivid graphics and deep colors. Moreover, the print is made on high-quality polyester fabric. The material is flexible but retains its shape. This makes it very easy to apply to the structure, and the fabric fits well on the aluminum frame. If the print gets dirty over time, you can wash it in a washing machine at 30 degrees Celsius. This way, your textile wall will remain in good condition for future promotional activities. Additionally, you should know that your company graphics can be printed on one or both sides. This option allows you to adjust the wall to your needs and the place where it will be displayed. If you change the graphics over time, you can simply order a new print for the existing structure. Quick tool-free assembly and easy transport Attracting customer attention and aesthetic appearance are not everything. At adsystem, we understand that exhibition systems must also be user-friendly. The construction of the adWall Vario Classic wall consists of aluminum tubes that you connect using snap locks. The individual elements are marked, so it's easy to follow the assembly sequence. As a result, your logo advertising wall will be quickly ready for promotional activities. No tools are needed to assemble the structure. We have also ensured convenient transport. Our products are packed in handy transport bags. This makes it easy to carry the packed wall to your stand.

You can easily integrate it with other adWall systems – adWall Vario Straight and adWall Vario Right. By combining different modules, you create a coherent and impressive promotional space. o.desc:
Advantages of the adBox Elypse Model By choosing the adBox Elypse, you are investing in a modern, functional, and durable sampling stand that will effectively support your marketing efforts. Functional Design The adBox Elypse is built with aluminum profiles and a high-quality tabletop, available in a palette of colors to choose from. Its sturdy base supports up to 100 kg, making it ideal for promoting larger products. Additionally, the stand is equipped with wheels, allowing for effortless relocation. Quick Assembly The adBox Elypse model stands out for its quick, tool-free assembly. Its modular construction allows the stand to be set up in just a few minutes. After the event, it can be easily disassembled and stored in a convenient carrying bag. Durability and Versatility The adBox Elypse is a long-term investment. The ability to easily replace graphic materials allows for reuse on various occasions. Personalized graphics can be quickly swapped out, adapting the product to current promotional needs. o.name: adFrame LMD 150x200 PK (without print)
o.desc:
Where to best utilize the double-sided LED panel?
Backdrop for speakers: The large dimensions and customization options make the adFrame LMD an excellent choice for industry events. Use the LED advertising panel as a backdrop for speakers at conferences or trade shows.
Trade show booths: Illuminated advertising banners placed around your booth will clearly define the boundaries of your exhibition space. They can also serve as separators to create dedicated trade sections, such as a relaxation zone.
Product advertising: The extensive advertising space provided by the adFrame LMD is perfect for presenting products in their realistic sizes. Therefore, the double-sided LED panel is suitable for use in furniture stores or car showrooms.
Advantages of the adFrame LMD LED Advertising Panel Customizable dimensions The illuminated advertising banners can be fully customized to your needs. In addition to the standard dimensions offered on the website, the adFrame LMD offers extensive customization options. If your advertisement requires, you can order a product with non-standard height and width. This allows you to create a unique exhibition system that stands out from the competition. Interchangeable personalized prints Just like the structure itself, the prints for the adFrame LMD are fully personalized. Your designs graphics will be placed on a durable textile material. The sublimation method used guarantees photographic print quality. Moreover, the double-sided LED panel allows for quick graphic exchanges, enabling you to display different content depending on the event. Intuitive assembly The adFrame LMD structure can be erected in a few minutes. Assembly involves connecting marked frame elements, onto which the print is then placed. The graphic material, made through the sublimation process, is sewn with a rubber band that perfectly fits the frame.

Where to best utilize the double-sided LED panel?
Backdrop for speakers: The large dimensions and customization options make the adFrame LMD an excellent choice for industry events. Use the LED advertising panel as a backdrop for speakers at conferences or trade shows.
Trade show booths: Illuminated advertising banners placed around your booth will clearly define the boundaries of your exhibition space. They can also serve as separators to create dedicated trade sections, such as a relaxation zone.
Product advertising: The extensive advertising space provided by the adFrame LMD is perfect for presenting products in their realistic sizes. Therefore, the double-sided LED panel is suitable for use in furniture stores or car showrooms.
Advantages of the adFrame LMD LED Advertising Panel Customizable dimensions The illuminated advertising banners can be fully customized to your needs. In addition to the standard dimensions offered on the website, the adFrame LMD offers extensive customization options. If your advertisement requires, you can order a product with non-standard height and width. This allows you to create a unique exhibition system that stands out from the competition. Interchangeable personalized prints Just like the structure itself, the prints for the adFrame LMD are fully personalized. Your designs graphics will be placed on a durable textile material. The sublimation method used guarantees photographic print quality. Moreover, the double-sided LED panel allows for quick graphic exchanges, enabling you to display different content depending on the event. Intuitive assembly The adFrame LMD structure can be erected in a few minutes. Assembly involves connecting marked frame elements, onto which the print is then placed. The graphic material, made through the sublimation process, is sewn with a rubber band that perfectly fits the frame.

o.name: adFrame Smart 100x250
o.desc:
Lightbox LED – applications
Exhibition stand: The durable PVC frames can be connected, making adFrame Smart a successful component of a mobile exhibition stand.
Office space arrangement: The LED lightbox can serve as an information carrier in the office. Moreover, when placed horizontally, it can act as a space divider.
Industry events: Thanks to the dual-sided illumination feature, adFrame Smart helps you stand out during the next meeting or industry event.
LED Light Box – advantages of the adFrame Smart model Dual-sided illumination LED bulbs in the adFrame Smart are placed at the top and bottom of the frame. This ensures that the entire print is evenly illuminated on both sides, increasing the reach and visibility of your advertising materials. Intuitive installation AdFrame Smart is the most intuitive lightbox available in the adsystem offer. Its assembly is tool-free and involves linking appropriately marked components with plastic connectors. All electrical wiring is internally routed, requiring no additional cable connections, only a 220V outlet. The LED light box is standardly packed in a custom-sized bag. For larger models, a handy wheeled bag is included. Full customization You can fully adjust the LED lightbox to your needs. The model is available in six sizes. If none of them meet your expectations, you can order additional connectors to extend the system, creating a personalized structure. Moreover, the support legs in the adFrame Smart can be extended and placed on the other side. This allows you to set it both vertically and horizontally.

o.name: adWall Vario curved 240 Ø43 double sided
o.desc:
adWall Vario Curved Premium – where and when can you use it? Our trade show walls are products with universal application. Here are some proven ways to use adWall Vario Curved Premium.
Trade shows and promotions: The trade show wall is the perfect backdrop for your booth at trade shows or during promotions in shopping centers. The surface printed with your company's graphics will become the backdrop for the exhibition area, making it stand out.
Conferences: The adWall Vario Curved Premium product is useful during conferences. Speakers can present in front of it, which will additionally enhance the message promoting the event. It can also serve as a backdrop for interviews with participants or organizers.
Office chillout area: You can diversify the interior design of your office or promote various internal activities using walls. In such cases, the wall can be placed in areas where employees gather for longer periods, such as the relaxation zone, near the open workspace, or the cafeteria.
Sport and industry events: The interview wall is also useful at sports and industry events. You can place the logos of the event's sponsors on the material, which will highlight their brands during press interviews with athletes or meeting participants.
adWall Vario Curved Premium – what are the benefits of using it? The adWall Vario Curved Premium trade show wall is a product that will improve the effectiveness of your promotional activities. See why it’s worth choosing our products. Eye-catching, curved shape that attracts attention The aluminum structure of the wall follows the line of a horizontal arch. This makes it stand out even more against other walls and the hall or shopping center itself. Choosing this product will help you attract potential customers and strengthen the impact of your promotional message. Clear and effective promotional message A trade show wall with your company logo or graphics is a clear message to the surroundings. At adsystem, we strive to ensure our products are made from the highest quality components – the printing preparation process undergoes several stages of quality control. This guarantees you receive a trade show wall that will become an impressive showcase for your brand. High-quality prints When preparing the walls, we use the sublimation printing method. This is not only an eco-friendly technique but also a proven way to achieve high-quality prints. Our fabrics with graphics are characterized by excellent color reproduction and clarity. Moreover, your trade show wall can be printed on one or both sides. This allows for precise adaptation of the product to the trade show booth or the room conditions. You should also know that this wall has an additional advantage over other exhibition systems. The printed material can be washed in an automatic washing machine at 30 degrees Celsius. This is particularly important because trade shows and promotions are busy events, and it’s easy for the fabric to get dirty. Quick assembly and convenient transportation Adsystem trade show walls are especially convenient to use. To assemble the wall at a trade show, you don’t need to bring any tools, as you just need to connect the tubes with snap locks. Moreover, with the handy transport bag, carrying the wall to the booth will be convenient and hassle-free. Sturdy and stable trade show wall The aluminum structure of the product consists of tubes with a diameter of 43 mm. It includes wide feet, which ensures overall stability. As a result, during trade shows and while working at the promotional booth, you don’t need to worry about the wall's durability.

To assemble the wall at a trade show, you don’t need to bring any tools, as you just need to connect the tubes with snap locks. Moreover, with the handy transport bag, carrying the wall to the booth will be convenient and hassle-free. As a result, during trade shows and while working at the promotional booth, you don’t need to worry about the wall's durability.

o.name: adWall Vario straight Light 240 double sided
o.desc:
Where can you use the adWall Vario Straight Light advertising wall? The Vario Straight Light wall can be used in various promotional activities, both at your companys headquarters and outside it.
Booth element: Modular exhibition walls work well as a backdrop for the presentation of your products and the entire exhibition booth. They help define the booth boundaries and enhance your advertising message.
Participation in conferences: You can place the adWall Vario Straight Light wall on stage to highlight the speakers area or to accentuate the room where the meeting will take place.
Company headquarters: The product can serve as a wall in the reception area, clearly indicating that potential clients have arrived at the right place. It can also be used as a press wall in the meeting room.
What are the benefits of using the AdWall Vario Straight Light exhibition wall? The adWall Vario Straight Light offers numerous benefits, making it a valuable tool for your promotional activities. Easy Transport and Mobility This straight textile wall is lightweight, thanks to its aluminum structure. This makes transporting the wall during trade shows and other events quick and efficient. You can choose between a standard transport bag or a wheeled container from our offer, making it even more convenient to move the wall around. Simple Assembly Our modular exhibition walls are designed with easy assembly in mind, ensuring even those without manual skills can set them up effortlessly. The press wall you are looking at features tool-free assembly. The various components are connected quickly using snap locks, allowing you to set up the textile wall at trade shows or other events without needing tools, saving you time. Washable Fabrics Importantly, the adWall Vario Straight Light features a printed material that can be machine washed at 30 degrees Celsius. This means that even if the material gets dirty during a promotion, you can easily restore it to its original state. Consequently, the wall and print become reusable products, accompanying you to various industry meetings and trade shows. High-Quality Print Construction Your graphic materials are printed on the fabric using an eco-friendly sublimation printing method. This process results in vivid and bright colors, ensuring the wall looks impressive and catches the eye of trade show participants or promotion attendees. You can opt for single-sided printing if it will be viewed from only one side. We also offer double-sided prints. Additionally, you should know that the prints on the structure can be replaced over time. If you change your logo or company presentation style, you can simply order a new print from us. Textile Walls in Various Shapes The product presented here is a straight textile wall, but adSystem also offers curved walls and other shapes. We have prepared modular exhibition walls in various sizes, so browse our assortment and choose the optimal systems for your business.

o.name: adStand L 60
o.desc:
adWall L – where and when can it be used? The adWall L banner wall is a versatile exhibition system. With the product available in various sizes, you can easily customize the banner to meet your specific needs.
Service Facility: If you run your own business, the banner wall can serve as an advertising medium or a means of communication with your surroundings. Using banner walls, you can inform your audience about themed events, products, special services, and certifications.
Offices and Institutions: In offices, a promotional wall can be used as an information medium to inform recipients about ongoing grants, training sessions, and projects. In museums, cultural centers, or theaters, you can disseminate announcements about current events and temporary exhibitions.
Promotional Campaigns: You can also successfully use the adWall L in various promotional campaigns. If you plan to set up a minimalist exhibition booth to present your company, ready-made advertising banners will be an excellent choice.
adWall L Banner Wall – What Are the Benefits of Using This Product? Ready-made advertising banners are a proven advertising medium that has been popular among exhibitors for many years. Here are a few reasons why you should choose the adWall L roll-up with a print. High-Quality Print and Clear Message We use solvent printing technology for preparing the banner. This method ensures that the graphics are vivid and the colors are deep, making the advertising message clear and attention-grabbing for potential customers. Budget-Friendly Solution The banner wall is an excellent choice if you are looking for an economical advertising medium. The roll-up presented here is a budget-friendly solution. Despite this, thanks to the use of high-quality materials, it can serve you in many future promotional activities. Easy Assembly and Transport The banner wall is characterized by its ease of assembly. To set up the banner, you just need to unfold the print and place it on the expandable mast. Importantly, this task does not require the use of any tools, making this product an ideal solution even if you lack manual skills. Reusable At adsystem, the attractive appearance of our products always goes hand in hand with quality craftsmanship. Therefore, with proper use, our banner will serve you for a long time.

o.name: adStand Light 85
o.desc:
What are the benefits of using the custom roll-up banner adStand Light? The custom roll-up banner is a classic advertising medium, perfect for attracting attention to your stand and effectively conveying key information. Here are the benefits of choosing the adStand Light custom roll-up banner. High-quality printingIn the production of our custom roll-up banners, we use advanced printing techniques. This ensures high-quality prints with deep, well-saturated colors. As a result, this custom roll-up banner becomes an attractive showcase for your brand and an effective promotional medium. It's important to note that we use blockout banner material to manufacture the product. This material is opaque, meaning it doesn’t let light through. Therefore, even if the roll-up is placed near a window, the print will maintain excellent appearance. Easy setup and convenient transportTo set up the custom roll-up banner, you don't need any tools. Simply extend the pole (the components are connected with an elastic cord), secure it in place, and pull up the promotional banner. The entire structure is very lightweight, weighing only 4 kg. The set includes a convenient carrying bag, making it easy to transport the custom roll-up banner, especially for off-site promotional activities. What’s included in the set?
Structure with pole, cassette, and support stand,
Printed banner,
Carrying bag.
Technical specifications:
Materials: aluminum, blockout banner,
Pole components are connected with an elastic cord.

o.name: adTribune Big Quick
o.desc:
Advantages of the adTribune Big Quick Instant setup Thanks to its pneumatic mechanism, the adTribune Big Quick can be assembled quickly and effortlessly. Simply lift the countertop slightly, and the structure automatically rises, stretching the promotional fabric. This portable promotional counter is ready in just a few seconds, making it ideal for dynamic events. Large promotional surface The Big Quick model, compared to the bestseller Quick, features larger dimensions and more promotional space. The fabric surrounding the entire structure ensures excellent visibility of the advertising message from all angles, while the plastic countertop serves as a base for displaying additional materials. Interchangeable graphics Equipped with a graphic replacement system, the portable promotional counter allows easy customization for different events and advertising campaigns. If you already have the structure, you can simply order a new fabric graphic. The silicone-edged graphic is easily applied by sliding the silicone strip into the countertop groove. Self-assembling structure
Textile print
Transport bag

Maximum load: 5 kg

o.name: adTribune Elypse
o.desc:

aluminum structure on wheels,
countertop and shelf made of furniture board,
print on foil, secured with laminate,
transport bag.

o.name: adWall Vario Gate
o.product_type: Original Shapes exhibition systems > Textile gates
o.desc:
Benefits of Using the Vario Gate Arch-Type Advertising Gate Unique Arch Shape The Vario Gate is characterized by its distinctive three-dimensional arch form. This shape catches the eye and allows for effective advertisement display, as graphics and text messages are clearly visible. High-Quality Print on Textile Material We use sublimation printing technology on textiles, ensuring excellent color reproduction and high graphic quality. As a result, the arch-type advertising gate will seamlessly integrate with your brands visual identity and accurately reflect the intended graphic concept. Tool-Free Aluminum Construction The Vario Gate features an aluminum structure that is both lightweight and durable. To set up the gate, no tools are required, as the assembly is tool-free thanks to the snap-lock system. This significantly simplifies and speeds up the assembly process. Even individuals without assembly experience can quickly and efficiently set up the gate. Single or Double-Sided Print The option to use single or double-sided prints allows you to perfectly tailor the advertisement to the architectural conditions of the promotion venue. With double-sided printing, the advertisement is visible from various directions, increasing its reach and effectiveness. This ensures that your advertising messages reach a broader audience. Washable Prints The textile prints of the Vario Gate can be machine washed at temperatures up to 30°C, making them easy to maintain. As a result, the product will serve you well during subsequent promotional events and will always look good. Stable Construction The Vario Gate is designed to ensure maximum stability, which is crucial during intense events with a large number of participants. The solid construction guarantees that your advertisement will be displayed safely and securely. Convenient Transport When folded, the Vario Gate advertising gate takes up little space, making it easy to transport and store. The set includes a transport bag, further facilitating the movement of the gate to various events. What the Set Includes:
Aluminum frame
Textile print
Transport bag
Assembly instructions

o.desc:

Vario Island is an ideal solution for companies looking for exhibition systems that will emphasize the professional character of the brand and distinguish it from the competition. This effectively separates your booth from the surroundings. High-Quality Textile Print The culmination of the Vario Island presentation wall construction is the print placed on textile material. The set includes the structure and the print.

Advantages of the adWall Vario Peak model Unique shape The adWall Vario Peak wall stands out with its unique, dynamic shape that immediately catches the eye. The slightly rounded structure creates a promotional space where you can set up your booth, leaflet stand, or promoted products. Interchangeable prints The adWall Vario Peak wall is practical and functional. You can use the existing structure multiple times, even if your promotional needs change. o.name: adTent Vario 3x3 (frame+roof)
o.desc:
Benefits of the AdTent Vario Market Tent The AdTent Vario foldable tents offer multiple benefits. In addition to being made from high-quality materials, they are available in various sizes. For example, if you are looking for 3x3 or 4x4 tents, you will find these options in our range. Discover why you should choose the AdTent Vario tent for your business. Quick and Easy Setup The setup system of the AdTent Vario tents stands out for its speed and simplicity. The aluminum structure is equipped with snap locks, allowing you to assemble and disassemble the tent without needing any tools. Simply adjust and secure the elements to ensure a safe and efficient setup. Effective and Long-Lasting Advertising The market tent with personalized printing, available in sizes such as 3x3, is an excellent advertising platform. The roof and sidewalls can be decorated with your designs, helping to highlight your brand and strengthen its image with the public. Furthermore, the modular design allows for easy replacement of prints, facilitating updates to your visual communication without replacing the structure. Protection Against Weather Conditions The AdTent Vario market tent effectively protects your stand against adverse weather conditions. The impregnated fabric prevents moisture absorption and offers protection from intense sunlight, ensuring a comfortable environment for exhibitors and visitors. Versatility of the AdTent Vario Market Tent Outdoor Use With solid support bases, the AdTent Vario market tent is ideal for outdoor events such as festivals, concerts, and fairs. The impregnated polyester fabric provides resistance against light rain, making it a safe option in moderate weather conditions. Indoor Use The AdTent Vario tent is also ideal for events in indoor spaces such as trade fairs, promotions, and exhibitions in shopping centers. In these cases, the tent not only serves as a space delimiter but also as an advertising platform that attracts public attention. Technical Specifications

Depth: 320 cm
Unit Weight: 62 kg

Tool-free assembly

The tall construction makes your advertisement visible from a great distance and effectively attracts the attention of potential customers. aluminum structure,
printed textile material,
transport bag.

o.name: adUp Vario Trapfloat double sided
o.desc:
Benefits of Using the Vario Trapfloat Truncated Cone Shaped Advertising Hanger Unique Shape Vario Trapfloat features an unconventional truncated cone shape that draws attention and makes your advertisement more noticeable. It works great when hung above a booth at trade shows or used to mark larger interiors. By placing appropriate communication on the product, you can indicate areas such as the checkout zone or fitting rooms to your audience. Large Advertising Surface This advertising hanger offers a large surface area for presenting graphics and marketing messages. This increases your chances of catching the audience’s attention and ultimately improves the effectiveness of your promotional efforts. High-Quality Textile Print We use sublimation printing on textiles to prepare these products. This eco-friendly method guarantees vibrant colors and sharp graphic details. Thus, your advertisement will look professional, and the truncated cone shaped hanger will become an impressive showcase for your brand. Tool-Free Aluminum Construction The Vario Trapfloat structure is based on an aluminum frame system. Connecting the frames does not require any tools as the components snap together. This makes assembly quick and simple, saving time and easing preparation for events. Washable Prints The prints for this truncated cone shaped advertising hanger are made on polyester material. This fabric can be machine washed at temperatures up to 30 degrees Celsius. Even if the print gets dirty over time, you can easily restore it to its original appearance. Stretchable Material During Installation The textile material stretches during installation due to the addition of stretch, making the process easier and preventing creases during transport. This ensures your advertisement always looks perfect. Convenient Transport When disassembled, Vario Trapfloat takes up little space and can be easily transported even by a personal car. The set includes a transport bag, which further facilitates carrying and storing the product. What’s Included in the Set?
Aluminum frame
Textile print
Transport bag

Stores and service salons: perfect for displaying advertisements and information, visible from both sides due to the double-sided design.

Advantages of the adFrame DTF model The adFrame DTF model is a practical advertising solution that will help you stand out from the crowd. Double-sided advertising message The adFrame DTF frame is equipped with double-sided prints. Displaying graphics from both sides enhances visibility and effectiveness of the message, making it especially useful in high-traffic areas. Interchangeable prints Textile frames allow for the exchange of prints thanks to a silicone mounting system. To prepare the product for fairs or promotions, simply assemble the structure and slide the gasket-lined material into the frame slot. Changing graphics is quick and simple, allowing you to easily adapt adFrame DTF for different campaigns. The option to order new prints for an already owned frame is an economical solution that will serve you for years. Intuitive assembly The assembly and disassembly of adFrame DTF are tool-free and extremely intuitive. Specially designed connectors and marked elements of the structure allow for trouble-free setting up and taking down of the system, making the frame ready for use in just a few minutes, saving time and facilitating booth preparation. What does the set include?
aluminum structure,
textile material lined with a gasket.

o.name: adFrame STF 100x100 (without print)
o.desc:
What is the best place to use a suspended textile frame?
Store: adFrame STF is an ideal solution for stores where frequent changes of advertisements are required. The suspended system allows for quick adaptation of the decor to current promotions.
Office decoration: the frame also serves as a modern office decoration, catching the eye of clients and adding elegance to the interior.
Service salon: in service salons, adFrame STF can function as an aesthetic carrier of information about the offered services.
Advantages of the adFrame STF model Choosing adFrame STF, you invest in a multifunctional advertising medium that will make your company stand out in the market. Suspended advertisement A suspended textile frame, placed in strategic locations, will effectively catch the eyes of customers. Wall-mounted advertising allows for efficient use of space, which is especially important in small rooms. Interchangeable prints Prints with your design will be applied to a material edged with a silicone strip, which should be inserted into the frame slot during installation. This system enables quick application and removal of graphics, allowing you to easily adapt adFrame STF to different advertising campaigns. Simply order a new print that you can apply to the existing structure. Intuitive installation Assembling the frame does not require any tools. Its individual elements are appropriately marked and can be assembled thanks to special connectors. The intuitive system allows you to set up adFrame STF in just a few minutes. What does the set include?
aluminum frame,
textile material with print,
accessories needed for suspension (hooks).

o.name: adFrame CTF 30x30x120
o.desc:
What is the best place to use a cube-shaped textile frame?
Stores: as a podium for product display, adFrame CTF will catch the eyes of customers and showcase products in an attractive manner.
Trade shows and exhibitions: as a suspended element or podium, the lightbox increases booth visibility and allows for creative spatial arrangements.
Offices and service salons: adFrame CTF also serves as a modern decoration, adding elegance and professionalism to any interior.
Advantages of the adFrame CTF model Spatial construction The adFrame CTF model is a spatial structure. Depending on the dimensions you choose, it can take the form of a cube or a rectangular prism. A cube-shaped advertisement allows for creating a unique display that serves as a podium for products or a suspended element. Your graphics will be visible from every side, which helps in attracting the attention of customers. Interchangeable prints The cube-shaped textile lightbox, like other models of this type, is equipped with interchangeable prints. The simple system of assembly and disassembly of materials with graphics facilitates the adaptation of the advertising message to the changing needs of the brand. Intuitive assembly To assemble the adFrame CTF structure, you do not need any tools. Specially designed connectors and marked elements of the structure allow for quick assembly and disassembly of the system. This makes the lightbox ready to use in just a few minutes, saving time and facilitating the preparation of the display. What does the set include?
aluminum structure,
printed material.

o.name: adFrame LMD 100x100 PK Hanging (without print)
o.desc:
What is the best place to use adFrame LMD hanging?
Trade shows: The LED suspended advertising panel is an excellent addition to your trade show booth, providing extra advertising space.
Stores and shopping malls: Make your promotion stand out from the competition with a lighted advertisement visible from a distance.
Car dealerships: Use the adFrame LMD hanging as a product advertisement in your dealership to give additional exposure to promoted offers.
Advantages of the adFrame LMD hanging model Additional promotional space The hanging display system allows you to utilize additional advertising space. With the adFrame LMD, previously unused areas above the trade show booth will attract the attention of potential customers from afar. Customizable advertisement The adFrame LMD hanging box is available in a wide range of sizes. You can choose between a horizontal or vertical advertisement layout. Moreover, besides standard options, we also offer custom-sized products. This allows you to easily adapt the LED suspended advertising panel to your project. Even illumination The LED diodes in the adFrame LMD hanging are placed on the edge of the frame. Thanks to the sublimation printing method and the use of materials with light-diffusing properties, this arrangement enables even illumination of the graphic. Additionally, the LED lighting used is characterized by very low energy consumption. What's included in the set?
aluminum structure with LED lighting,
printed material,
built-in power supply,
mounting components.

What is the best place to use adFrame LMD hanging?
Trade shows: The LED suspended advertising panel is an excellent addition to your trade show booth, providing extra advertising space.
Stores and shopping malls: Make your promotion stand out from the competition with a lighted advertisement visible from a distance.
Car dealerships: Use the adFrame LMD hanging as a product advertisement in your dealership to give additional exposure to promoted offers.
Advantages of the adFrame LMD hanging model Additional promotional space The hanging display system allows you to utilize additional advertising space. With the adFrame LMD, previously unused areas above the trade show booth will attract the attention of potential customers from afar. Customizable advertisement The adFrame LMD hanging box is available in a wide range of sizes. You can choose between a horizontal or vertical advertisement layout. Moreover, besides standard options, we also offer custom-sized products. This allows you to easily adapt the LED suspended advertising panel to your project. Even illumination The LED diodes in the adFrame LMD hanging are placed on the edge of the frame. Thanks to the sublimation printing method and the use of materials with light-diffusing properties, this arrangement enables even illumination of the graphic. Additionally, the LED lighting used is characterized by very low energy consumption. What's included in the set?
aluminum structure with LED lighting,
printed material,
built-in power supply,
mounting components.

o.name: Print adWall Smart curved 4x3
o.desc:
Applications of the adWall Smart Curved Wall The Smart pop-up curved wall can be used at various events, both at your company's premises and outside. Discover how to best utilize this exhibition system.
Advertising Stand Element: The magnetic wall serves as a backdrop for your company's booth at trade shows or other promotional events. The extensive cross reinforcements strengthen the structure, ensuring stability even when a crowd of potential customers gathers around the booth.
Promotional Stand: The adWall Smart Curved comes with a transport bag. After setting up the wall, you can place the case in a vertical position and use it as a counter. This way, you create a complete and professional promotional stand.
Office Decoration: The pop-up curved wall can also be used at your company's headquarters. You can place it in the reception area to welcome guests from the entrance or in the conference room to create a backdrop for speaking employees.
Key Advantages of the Magnetic Wall Stable Construction The adWall Smart Curved features an innovative design. Its self-locking mechanism makes assembly and disassembly easy while ensuring the wall's stability. The frame, supported by cross reinforcements, is made of drawn aluminum – a durable and lightweight material. High-Quality Graphics The prints for the wall are made on PVC material. These prints are characterized by high resolution and excellent color reproduction. They do not let light through and do not reflect glare. The prints are mounted on magnetic strips, making installation easy and ensuring the graphics adhere precisely to the structure. 3D Effect The magnetic wall is built on an arc base, standing out from classic, straight exhibition systems. The rounded sides, entirely covered with the print, create a 3D effect. As a result, the wall becomes not only a backdrop but also an advertising space. Customization Options The pop-up curved wall is available in two sizes. You can adjust its width to the needs of your booth. Additionally, you can equip the wall with LED lighting. The included transport case can easily be used as a counter. All of this allows you to create a unique advertising booth with a single product.

acc.name: Print for adWall Smart transport case

o.name: Print Adtent Air premium 3x3 (roof)
o.desc: What Are the Benefits of the Inflatable Tent adTent Air Premium? Inflatable tents are widely used at various promotional events. Discover why this type of advertising support should be part of your next event planning. Inflatable Tent That Protects Against Weather Conditions The inflatable tent adTent Air Premium is ideal for outdoor events. The roof and sidewalls provide protection against sun, wind, and rain. Moreover, the material used to manufacture our advertising tents is durable and impregnated, ensuring it does not absorb moisture. Even in rainy weather, your stand and displayed products will remain protected. Constant Pressure Tent as an Advertising Medium The inflatable tents from adTent stand out not only for their comfort of use, even in adverse weather conditions, but also as effective advertising mediums. Customized prints on the structure ensure that your promotional stand is visible from afar, making it easy for visitors to identify your brand, even at crowded events. We use advanced printing techniques to deliver high-quality graphics with vibrant, intense colors, making the inflatable tent adTent Air Premium an impressive showcase for your brand. Eye-Catching Spider-Shaped Inflatable Tent One of the unique features of the adTent Air Premium inflatable tents is their visually striking structure. The presented model is a spider-shaped tent, consisting of four supports that converge at the top of the structure, creating a modern and captivating design. Constant Pressure Tent The adTent Air Premium is an inflatable tent equipped with special valves that maintain constant pressure inside the chambers. As a result, it only needs to be inflated once at the beginning of the event, and the structure will remain stable without requiring additional air adjustments. Where and When to Use the Inflatable Tent adTent Air Premium? The inflatable tent adTent Air Premium is a versatile solution, suitable for a wide range of occasions, both outdoors and indoors. Tent for Concerts and Festivals This inflatable tent is perfect for promotional activities at large outdoor events, such as concerts or festivals. The corporate symbols printed on the tent not only enhance your brand's visibility but also help to distinctly mark the event. Inflatable Tent for Beach Bars and Terraces It can also be used in fixed outdoor display spaces, such as beach bars or restaurant terraces. In such cases, the event tent can protect outdoor dining areas or bars from adverse weather conditions. Tent for Indoor Events Another way to utilize these inflatable tents is during events held indoors. The fabric used for the roof and walls is fire-resistant certified, ensuring safety in such environments. In these cases, the tent can serve as a marker for important event areas or even as an eye-catching entrance to the venue.

o.name: adTent Air premium 4x6 (frame + roof)
o.desc: What Are the Benefits of the Inflatable Tent adTent Air Premium? Inflatable tents are widely used at various promotional events. Discover why this type of advertising support should be part of your next event planning. Inflatable Tent That Protects Against Weather Conditions The inflatable tent adTent Air Premium is ideal for outdoor events. The roof and sidewalls provide protection against sun, wind, and rain. Moreover, the material used to manufacture our advertising tents is durable and impregnated, ensuring it does not absorb moisture. Even in rainy weather, your stand and displayed products will remain protected. Constant Pressure Tent as an Advertising Medium The inflatable tents from adTent stand out not only for their comfort of use, even in adverse weather conditions, but also as effective advertising mediums. Customized prints on the structure ensure that your promotional stand is visible from afar, making it easy for visitors to identify your brand, even at crowded events. We use advanced printing techniques to deliver high-quality graphics with vibrant, intense colors, making the inflatable tent adTent Air Premium an impressive showcase for your brand. Eye-Catching Spider-Shaped Inflatable Tent One of the unique features of the adTent Air Premium inflatable tents is their visually striking structure. The presented model is a spider-shaped tent, consisting of four supports that converge at the top of the structure, creating a modern and captivating design. Constant Pressure Tent The adTent Air Premium is an inflatable tent equipped with special valves that maintain constant pressure inside the chambers. As a result, it only needs to be inflated once at the beginning of the event, and the structure will remain stable without requiring additional air adjustments. Where and When to Use the Inflatable Tent adTent Air Premium? The inflatable tent adTent Air Premium is a versatile solution, suitable for a wide range of occasions, both outdoors and indoors. Tent for Concerts and Festivals This inflatable tent is perfect for promotional activities at large outdoor events, such as concerts or festivals. The corporate symbols printed on the tent not only enhance your brand's visibility but also help to distinctly mark the event. Inflatable Tent for Beach Bars and Terraces It can also be used in fixed outdoor display spaces, such as beach bars or restaurant terraces. In such cases, the event tent can protect outdoor dining areas or bars from adverse weather conditions. Tent for Indoor Events Another way to utilize these inflatable tents is during events held indoors. The fabric used for the roof and walls is fire-resistant certified, ensuring safety in such environments. In these cases, the tent can serve as a marker for important event areas or even as an eye-catching entrance to the venue.

o.name: adTent EXPRESS 3x3m (frame+Print roof)
o.desc:
What Are the Benefits of adTent Express Customized Tents? Customized tents for events are among the most sought-after products on the market and offer numerous advantages. Discover why you should choose adsystem’s tents. Protection from Sun and RainThese tents are designed to protect you from adverse weather conditions. The fabric used for the roof and side walls is waterproof, preventing moisture from passing through. Additionally, the material partially blocks sunlight, providing extra comfort even on sunny days. Tents as Advertising ToolsThe adTent Express customized tents are also highly effective advertising tools. The roof and side walls can be personalized with your brand’s graphics, helping to highlight your logo and reinforce your brand identity among your customers. Using advanced printing technologies, we deliver high-quality images with vibrant colors, making the tents an excellent promotional asset. Quick and Easy Setup SystemThe adTent Express tents stand out for their simple and intuitive assembly system. The top part of the structure consists of aluminum rods in an accordion design, which allows the roof to open automatically as you extend the legs of the tent outward. Setup can be done by just two people without the need for any tools, making the process quick and efficient. Available in Various SizesAt adsystem, we understand that every customer has specific needs. That’s why we offer customized tents in various sizes, including popular options like 3x3 m and 3x6 m, catering to events of different scales and types. Where to Use adTent Express Customized Tents? The advent Express customized tents are versatile solutions that can be used in various contexts, both outdoors and indoors. Outdoor EventsIdeal for festivals, concerts, and outdoor promotions, these tents provide sun protection while creating a visible brand presence at the event. In large venues, a 3x3 m customized tent can serve as a reference point for participants. Indoor EventsThese tents are also an excellent solution for trade shows and events held in indoor spaces, such as large pavilions. The material used for the side walls and roof is certified fire-resistant, ensuring safety in enclosed environments. Technical Specifications:
Height: 340 cm
Width: 300 cm
Depth: 300 cm
Unit Weight: 26 kg
Applications:
Stand elements
Concerts and festivals
Sports events
Promotions and marketing campaigns
Key Product Features:
Tool-free assembly
Suitable for indoor and outdoor use
Reusable structure

o.name: adWall Edge Plus 1x3S SS
o.desc:
Applications of the adWall Edge The magnetic pop-up wall can be used in various marketing campaigns. How can you fully utilize the potential of this product?
Promotional Booth: With the adWall Edge, your company’s booth at trade shows, conferences, and industry meetings will gain a professional character. A hostess or promoter will immediately draw the attention of potential customers against its backdrop.
Interior Design: When designing an office or service space, company symbols should not be forgotten. By placing your logo on the wall in the reception area or at the entrance, you reinforce the brand’s image in the minds of customers.
Advantages of the Magnetic Pop-Up Wall Intuitive Construction The adWall Edge is based on an accordion-style construction that should take no more than a few minutes to set up. Aluminum elements are connected with snap fasteners, making the assembly tool-free. You can transport the entire structure in the bag included with the product. Interchangeable Prints Prints for the adWall Edge are made on flexible polyester fabric. The sublimation printing method ensures durability and high-quality graphics. Moreover, our website offers the option to purchase the prints separately. So if you change your company’s visual identity over time or prepare a new promotional campaign, you can order materials to fit the existing structure. Customization Options The magnetic pop-up wall is available in three sizes, allowing you to easily fit it to the dimensions of your booth or office space. If you want your graphics to be illuminated, you can order an additional LED installation.

o.name: pump electric BRAVO
o.product_type: Accessories and advertising stands > Accessories and advertising lightning
o.desc: Efficiency and versatility The Bravo Electric Pump stands out with its impressive 600 W power. This allows you to quickly and easily reduce the volume of items like inflatable tents. Safety and reliability One of the key features of the Bravo Electric Pump is a special filter that prevents unwanted objects from being sucked into the device. Additionally, a thermal switch protects the pump from overheating. This ensures that the entire process is safe and reliable. Easy storage and transport Thanks to its compact size and lightweight design, the Bravo Electric Pump is easy to store and transport. The long pumping hose provides convenience, eliminating the need to constantly move the device.

o.name: pump electric standard
o.product_type: Accessories and advertising stands > Accessories and advertising lightning
o.desc: Quick and efficient pumping Our electric pump is designed to minimize preparation time for events. With 200 W of power, you can inflate any inflatable product in just a few minutes. This time and effort-saving feature allows you to focus on the event, reducing preparation to a minimum. Deflating function The electric pump not only inflates but also deflates, which is extremely useful for packing and storing products. Universal nozzles The pump comes with 4 different nozzles, allowing you to adapt the tool to specific tasks.

o.name: Pump hand standard
o.product_type: Accessories and advertising stands > Accessories and advertising lightning
o.desc: Dual-action pumping The hand pump enables pumping in both directions, significantly saving time and effort. With this function, your event preparations will be faster and more efficient. Deflating function Our hand pump is not only a tool for inflating but also for deflating air. This feature allows you to easily and conveniently regulate the pressure in various items, which is especially helpful when packing luggage or sealing vacuum bags. Universal nozzles The hand pump comes with three different nozzles, allowing you to adapt the tool to specific situations.

Discover the key advantages of AdSystem’s advertising banners. Clear Advertising Message The advertising banners are made from customized textile materials with printed graphics. This feature is crucial for strengthening your promotional efforts. We use advanced direct printing techniques to deliver sharp graphics and vibrant colors. As a result, the banner becomes an effective visual representation of your brand, enhancing the success of your promotional campaigns. Additionally, these banners assist in guiding participants, especially in large venues or open spaces. Tall and visible from a distance, they clearly indicate the location of your promotion. Easy Assembly and Convenient Transport One of the main advantages of advertising banners is their easy assembly. To set up the structure, simply connect the mast pieces and slide the banner through the tunnel at the fabric’s edge. This practical design allows for quick and hassle-free installation. Moreover, the set is lightweight and compact, making it easy to transport, particularly for events held outside the company’s premises. Durable Mast The advertising banners use fiberglass masts, a material highly resistant to mechanical damage, lightweight, and slightly flexible. o.name: adFlag HOOK XL
o.product_type: Outdoor advertising > Advertising flags and winders
o.desc:
What are the benefits of a custom-printed flag? Custom-printed flags are among the most popular advertising media, especially during outdoor events. However, you can use them in many different ways, including indoors. Discover the benefits of using a custom-printed flag. Clear advertising message To prepare flags with custom prints, we use direct printing technology. This allows us to achieve high-quality prints - the graphics on the flag are sharp and well-saturated with colors. As a result, this type of advertising medium will not only seamlessly integrate into your brand's visual identity system but also serve as an excellent way to mark a building or stand. This is especially important if you are organizing an event in a spacious interior or an open area. Moreover, the print is only on one side of the material. However, the fabric's weight is such that the graphic is also visible on the reverse side. Easy assembly and transport We have also ensured that the assembly of custom-printed flags is smooth and quick. To set up the structure, simply unfold the mast and slide the flag onto it. The material is sewn at the end in such a way that it forms a small tunnel through which you insert the mast. Additionally, the whole set is lightweight, so if you plan an event outside the company's headquarters, transporting the custom-printed flag will not be a problem. Durable materials The mast of the product presented here is made of a mix of aluminum and fiberglass. This combination of materials ensures resistance to adverse weather conditions and mechanical damage. What does the set include?
Custom-printed flag
Mast

o.desc:
Advertising Flags: Advantages and Benefits
Effective Promotional Communication:The advertising flag allows you to convey promotional messages in a visual and appealing way. The personalized fabric printing, created with advanced direct printing techniques, ensures high graphic quality and vibrant colors. Although printed on one side, the design is also visible on the reverse side of the fabric.
Clear Event Signage:Thanks to tall poles, advertising flags are visible from a distance. This is especially useful for outdoor events or large exhibition halls, where the flags help guide attendees to your space.
Durability and Reusability:The pole is made of aluminum combined with fiberglass, ensuring both strength and flexibility. This design enables the flags to withstand adverse weather conditions while maintaining stability and functionality.
Replaceable Printing:Adsystem products are standardized, allowing you to purchase new fabric prints without needing to replace the pole. This makes it easy to update your flag’s promotional message.
Easy Assembly and Disassembly:Advertising flags stand out for their intuitive assembly system. Simply set up the pole and slide the flag fabric, which is sewn into a tunnel shape, for a quick and secure fit. This system ensures the flag is ready for display in just a few minutes.

o.name: adFrame CTF 100x50x100 Hanging LED
o.desc:
What is the best place to use illuminated advertising signs?
Trade Booth: Ensure your booth is highly visible in the trade space by advertising from a higher level. The adFrame CTF LED panel helps you stand out against the competition and attract customers from across the hall.
Car Showroom: A hanging sign serves as a professional advertising medium in a car showroom. Placed above the products, it provides additional exposure.
Store: Highlight different areas in a large retail store by hanging an LED advertising panel with the appropriate logo or product name.
Advantages of the adFrame LED CTF model Modern hanging advertisement The adFrame LED CTF model utilizes advertising space that was previously overlooked. Filling the area above a booth or displayed product attracts potential customers' attention. The hanging panel is an excellent complement to promotional activities, ensuring greater brand visibility and exposure. Reusable system The graphic material is bordered with a silicone strip, facilitating easy installation and removal of the print. All you need to do is insert the strip into the frame slot. Additionally, this mechanism allows for the exchange of prints, for example, after a promotion ends. You can order a new graphic that fits seamlessly into the existing frame. This multifunctional and economical solution will serve you for years. Unique advertising medium AdFrame LED CTF cubes are custom-made. Their dimensions are tailored to fit your booth or advertising space. Regardless of size, you can choose a sign in the form of a cube or cuboid. By ordering an LED advertising panel, you ensure your promotional activities stand out from the competition.

Anuncios visibles desde ambos lados El diseño de doble cara permite maximizar la superficie publicitaria, asegurando que tu mensaje se vea desde cualquier dirección. Esto convierte al adBoard LED en una herramienta estratégica para captar la atención de los transeúntes. Resistente al clima Este producto está diseñado para soportar condiciones climáticas adversas, por lo que puede instalarse al aire libre sin problemas. Es ideal para colocar frente a locales comerciales, atrayendo la atención incluso en días de viento o lluvia. Funcionamiento fiable con energía eléctrica El sistema de iluminación LED funciona conectado a la red eléctrica, garantizando un rendimiento continuo sin necesidad de recargar baterías o cambiar acumuladores. Disponible en dos tamaños El adBoard LED se adapta a diferentes necesidades gracias a sus dos tamaños disponibles. Elige el que mejor se ajuste al espacio donde planeas utilizarlo. This allows the event backdrop stand to be reused multiple times. By ordering new fabric with updated graphics, you can adapt the appearance of your advertisement to different promotional campaigns and events. Additionally, the textile material is machine washable, ensuring it remains in impeccable condition for an extended period. o.name: SEGO internal connector L
o.product_type: Exhibition stands > SEGO - illuminated exhibition system
o.desc:
Advantages of SEGO connectors
Structural stabilitySEGO connectors provide a secure frame connection, ensuring the durability and safety of the entire structure.
Easy assemblyTool-free installation simplifies the setup process, saving time during booth preparation.
Aesthetic designPrecisely crafted elements blend seamlessly into the booth's structure, ensuring a cohesive and professional appearance.
Types of SEGO connectors
Internal L connectorDesigned for connecting frames at a 90° angle from the inside of the structure.
External L connectorEnables connecting frames at a 90° angle from the outside, ideal for corner setups.
Straight connectorUsed to join frames in a straight line, allowing the creation of long, uninterrupted walls.
Bridge connectorAllows for more complex, multi-level frame connections, expanding the system's design possibilities.
Technical aspects:
Material: high-quality metal,
Assembly: tool-free,
Compatibility: SEGO system,
Connection angles: 90° and 180°,
Precision fit for SEGO frames.
SEGO connectors are the perfect solution for companies seeking durable and functional accessories that enable the construction of stable, aesthetic, and modular trade show booths.

o.name: mFrame frame 496x992
o.product_type: Exhibition stands > mFrame - modular exhibition system
o.desc:
What are the benefits of mFrame frames? mFrame frames are perfect for creating modern trade show booths, exhibition walls, and all kinds of advertising displays. Tool-free assembly mFrame frames are designed for quick assembly without the need for specialized tools. Importantly, the frames come pre-assembled, so you only need to connect them using special connectors. This ensures that booth setup at trade shows is quick and efficient. Reinforced aluminum construction The mFrame frame is made of reinforced aluminum. As a result, the system is not only stable but also allows for hanging heavier items. This enables interesting displays of showcased products. Easy expansion and a wide range of accessories The mFrame system allows for connecting various modules depending on the exhibitors needs. Thanks to compatibility with other mFrame elements, you can create stands of any size and shape, perfectly tailored to your vision and needs. You can add various shelves, hangers, or additional lightboxes to the stand. 13 frame sizes To help you create a custom-made booth for your business, the mFrame configurator offers as many as 13 different frame sizes, as well as doors and connectors to adjust the structures width. What does the set include?
mFrame frame,
Mounting elements,
User manual.
Technical specifications:
Width: 49.6/99.2 cm,
Height: 49.6/99.2/124/148.8/198.4/248/297.6 cm,
Depth: 6.2 cm,
Weight: 6-14 kg,
Compatible with other mFrame modules,
Material: anodized aluminum.

o.name: mFrame 3x out connector
o.product_type: Exhibition stands > mFrame - modular exhibition system
o.desc:
What are the benefits of the mFrame internal connector? Stability and durability The mFrame internal connector is designed to provide stable and durable connections between system elements. Made from high-quality materials, it guarantees secure fastening and overall stability of the structure. Ease of installation The mFrame connector allows for quick assembly without the need for specialized tools. This simplifies the booth setup process, ensuring secure and precise connections between modules. Versatility The mFrame internal connector is compatible with various mFrame system modules, allowing for flexible booth configurations. This enables the creation of stable and expandable structures tailored to the specific needs of the display. In our configurator, you will find several types of connectors:
External/external connector: Joins 2 frames at a 90-degree angle, creating an empty space of 6.2x6.2 cm.
External/external/external connector: Joins 3 frames at a 90-degree angle, creating an empty space of 6.2x6.2 cm.
External/external/external/external connector: Joins 4 frames at a 90-degree angle, creating an empty space of 6.2x6.2 cm.
Internal/external connector: Joins 2 frames at a 90-degree angle, covering 6.2 cm of graphics on one of the frames.
LMD connector: Connects an mFrame frame with an LMD lightbox.
Adjustable frame connector: Used to change the width of the frame, which can be useful if your booth exceeds the allocated space.
What does the set include?
mFrame internal connector,
Installation manual.
Technical specifications:
Material: stainless steel,
Easy and quick assembly,
Compatibility with the mFrame system,
Stable module connection.

o.name: Multiframe 250 SET1 (Black)
o.product_type: Exhibition stands > Multiframe - modular exhibition system
o.desc:
Mobility and Convenience of Use One of the key advantages of the multiframe frame is its mobility. The construction can be disassembled into small elements that can be packed into convenient bags. This makes the entire set easy to transport—even with a personal car. Mobility and Convenience of Use One of the key advantages of the multiframe frame is its mobility. The construction can be disassembled into small elements that can be packed into convenient bags. This makes the entire set easy to transport—even with a personal car. This solution provides flexibility for moving between different events, which is especially important for companies that frequently participate in trade shows. Versatile Expansion Options The multiframe frame system offers a wide selection of accessories, such as covers, shelves, lights, and hanging panels, which allow you to further customize the booth to your needs. Thanks to these additions, booths based on the multiframe system become not only aesthetically pleasing but also an effective advertising tool that attracts the attention of potential customers. Option to Add a Storage Room The multiframe frame also allows for the easy addition of a storage room with system doors that can be locked. This practical solution allows for the storage of essential materials and provides a workspace away from visitors' view, enhancing the comfort of booth use. Technical Specifications:
Material: Lightweight but durable aluminum frames,
Tool-free assembly,
Possibility for modification and expansion with available accessories,
Color: Black, without print.

o.name: Print Multiframe Storage Room 250 - storage room side
o.product_type: Exhibition stands > Multiframe - modular exhibition system
o.desc:
Why choose prints for the multiframe frame? High-Quality Graphics The sublimation printing used in the multiframe frame prints ensures exceptional color depth and detail precision. This means that your booth will look professional, and the graphics will attract visitors' attention with sharp contrasts and vibrant colors. Whether your graphics are detailed or based on simple, clear messages, the sublimation technology perfectly reproduces the intended effects. Easy Installation The prints are trimmed with a special silicone beading, which makes mounting them on the frame easy. This makes booth setup quick and hassle-free, without the need for additional tools. This innovative design saves time and provides a stable connection, which is especially appreciated by those who frequently participate in trade events and need quick and efficient solutions. Durability and Ease of Transport The material used for the prints is polyester, which is wrinkle-resistant. This is especially important during transport, as the prints retain their aesthetic appearance even after being rolled up for a long time. You don't need to worry about ironing the material – simply mount it on the frame, and the presentation will immediately look neat and professional. Light Blockage Thanks to the use of a light-blocking material, multiframe prints are perfect for areas with a lot of sunlight, such as near windows. Even strong daylight does not negatively impact the visibility of the graphics, making the booth look great in any lighting conditions. This solution enhances layout possibilities, allowing you to position the booth anywhere without concerns about the impact of light on the display. What does the set include?
Prints for the multiframe frame,
Installation manual.
Technical Specifications:
Material: Polyester, wrinkle-resistant, light-blocking,
Printing Technique: Sublimation for high-quality colors,
Installation: Trimmed with silicone beading for easy mounting,
Compatibility: Fits all multiframe frames.

Stable connection I-shaped mFrame connectors ensure secure and safe connections of frames in a straight line, allowing for the construction of larger structures without compromising their stability. Quick installation I-shaped mFrame connectors allow for quick, tool-free installation, simplifying the booth construction process. Compatibility with the mFrame system I-shaped connectors are fully compatible with other mFrame system modules, allowing flexible adjustments to the structure according to user requirements. In our store, five types of I-shaped mFrame connectors are available, differing in length: 2, 4, 6, 12 pins, and a connector with adjustable spacing. These options allow you to adapt your structure to specific needs and requirements. What does the set include?
I-shaped mFrame connectors,
Installation manual.

Material: stainless steel,
Tool-free installation,
Compatibility with the mFrame system.

o.name: adFrame Poster 100x100 (bez wydruku)
o.desc:
The adFrame Poster textile panel is a lightweight and stylish marketing solution that looks great in shopping malls, museums, shop windows, beauty salons or company showrooms. Thanks to the interchangeable prints, it is easy to modify the interior design by simply ordering a graphic. The design remains the same! The textile overlays are made from high-quality polyester, which is resistant to stretching and abrasion. In addition, it is printed with a special technology that ensures vivid colours and a long service life. The sheathing itself is assembled so that it can be put on and taken off by one person who is familiar with the instructions included in the kit. Illuminated advertising for your business The adFrame Poster textile panels use the state-of-the-art solution of mounting LED strips on a light curtain, mounted using the SEG (backlight) method. As a result, the entire graphic is evenly illuminated and the whole is noticeable even from a very long distance. The illumination, i.e. the LED strips attached to the blockout curtain, is located at the back over the entire surface. By routing the light through the entire panel, the message on it is perfectly illuminated, easy to read and looks great. The LED strips themselves, on the other hand, are energy-efficient. Each diode uses no more than 10% of the energy of an incandescent bulb of the same wattage. Simple and intuitive assembly The main advantage of textile panels is their simple and light assembly, thanks to which everyone is able to dismantle the entire structure on their own. The entire process is carried out without the use of any tools; all that is needed is to connect the relevant components together using intuitive snap fasteners. This saves time and costs associated with hiring specialists and fitters. The LED illuminated light box can not only be placed directly on the wall, but also, with the help of special inbuilt holes, it can be suspended from the ceiling, presenting your marketing message from a height. A cost-effective advertising light box, it is available in a variety of sizes, allowing you to adapt it to your specific location and customer needs. Thanks to its lightness, it can be carried easily and used in various spaces. It is one of the best solutions for a professional and effective advertising campaign in any industry. Benefits:
economical, wall-mounted advertising light box, simple, express replacement of graphics, textile print with elastic band, reusable system, tool-free installation, LED backlighting.
Available dimensions:
70 cm x 100 cm 100 cm x 100 cm 100 cm x 150 cm 100 cm x 200 cm 100 cm x 250 cm 100 cm x 300 cm

o.name: mFrame exhibition stand - 2x3 I- shaped layout
o.product_type: Exhibition stands > Ready-made exhibition stand kits
o.desc: The mFrame exhibition system offers many applications. It can serve as a perfect advertising wall or a multifunctional built-in structure. That's why it works well as a trade show build-out, a retailer in traffic routes, as well as an element of a showroom or an aesthetically pleasing branding wall at a company's headquarters. The mFrame design is durable and sturdy. This means that you can use the same system again and again, replacing only the print itself on polyester material or PVC board. This saves you time and money for each subsequent event.A wide range of accessories is available for the mFrame system, such as shelves, a TV rack, a stand, panels with pendants, LED lighting or a storage room with a lockable door. This allows you to customize the set to your individual needs and create the perfect exhibition space. Ready-made mFrame Exhibition Stand Kits are a way to create unique and functional exhibition spaces. You can experiment, combine different elements and customize the design to suit your purposes.If you can't find a ready-made layout that meets your needs, contact us and we'll help you create your own unique mFrame trade show booth set.

o.name: SEGO Light Box 2x3 L - stand
o.product_type: Exhibition stands > Ready-made exhibition stand kits
o.desc:
What benefits does the SEGO LED construction offer? The SEGO LED build consists of modules measuring 100x250, 85x250 cm, or 300x250 cm, which in the finished version are arranged in three shapes: an inline booth (enclosed on three sides), an island, or a corner configuration. Illuminated trade booths – stand out from the competition A trade booth prepared using SEGO freestanding trade boxes is a great way to create a comfortable workspace and stand out during trade shows. The construction will delineate the boundaries of your booth, and the walls will feature graphics with personalized prints. Thanks to the LED lighting placed on the side edges of the modules, the graphics will be evenly illuminated, making them even more visible. This ensures that your promotional booth will be noticeable from afar, and potential customers will surely pay attention. Tool-free assembly The system that our illuminated SEGO trade booths are based on allows for tool-free assembly. Each of the ready-made sets presented here comes with connectors that allow you to efficiently connect the individual modules. As a result, you do not have to worry about bringing an additional toolbox to the trade shows. High-quality interchangeable prints Our SEGO freestanding trade boxes are finished with textile prints that are applied on both sides of the frame. This ensures the booth is well visible from various directions. At adsystem, we strive to ensure our products are not only practical but also of high quality. Therefore, to prepare the prints for your LED build, we will use the sublimation printing method. This is an ecological and modern printing technique that ensures the graphics are of great quality, with well-saturated colors. Moreover, the textile material on which we place the prints disperses light very well. As a result, the graphics on the illuminated trade booths look very impressive. You should also know that if you change the graphic concept of your booth over time, you can order just the prints for your existing construction. Additionally, you can choose extra accessories for your booth such as shelves or a TV panel. Freestanding trade boxes for years To make the sets presented here, we use aluminum, which ensures the durability of the construction. As a result, the LED build will serve you in good condition for a long time during subsequent trade events. Accessories for LED builds Importantly, you can equip your illuminated trade booths with a range of practical accessories that make the booth even more comfortable to use and enhance the effectiveness of your work. These include hangers, shelves, or a TV stand. Where and under what circumstances can you use illuminated trade booths? Freestanding trade boxes are products designed with trade shows in mind. However, they are also a great solution if you are preparing your company for promotional activities, for example, in large shopping centers and galleries. Technical aspects:
materials: aluminum and polyester,
LED lighting,
tool-free assembly,
frame width: 12 cm,
possibility of building a small office.
Dimensions:
3x2 m,
3x3 m,
5x4 m,
4x3 m.
Module height: 250 cm (with the possibility of modification to 300 cm).
