o.name: Foldable 3x2 U stand
o.product_type: Exhibition stands > Ready-made exhibition stand kits
o.desc:
The Foldable trade show booth is available in the following ready-made configurations:
Inline, enclosed on three sides,
Peninsula, composed of one wall,
Corner, consisting of two walls connected at a right angle.
We offer both small and larger booth variants. These types of booths do not have internal LED lighting, shelves, or small offices. What benefits does the Foldable system provide? The Foldable trade show set is a system that allows you to prepare well for participation in trade shows or promotions in shopping centers or to arrange a meeting place with clients in a service salon. See the benefits of using the system presented here. Economical promotional stands If you want to design a simple booth that will attract the attention of potential customers and is also an economical solution, the Foldable system is a great choice. It is the most budget-friendly option in our offer. Clear advertising message Aluminum modules of the promotional booth will feature prints with your personalized graphics. In the printing process, we use the sublimation printing technique, which allows for high-quality graphics and well-saturated colors. As a result, the advertising media at your trade show booth will attract the attention of viewers and distinguish your brand from the competition. Lightweight construction and tool-free assembly Another important benefit provided by the Foldable trade show set is tool-free assembly. Individual modules can be connected using connectors included in the set. After assembly, both small trade show booths and the larger sizes available here can be packed into handy bags the size of a classic roll-up. Their transport is not troublesome because the constructions are very lightweight. Technical aspects:
Materials: aluminum and polyester,
Tool-free assembly,
Module dimensions: 100x250 cm.

o.name: Multiframe 250 2x3 L stand
o.product_type: Exhibition stands > Ready-made exhibition stand kits
o.desc:
What benefits does the use of the Multiframe trade booth construction offer? Among the ready-made sets presented here, you will find three basic configurations:
Inline booth (enclosed on three sides).
Corner booth composed of two walls meeting at a right angle.
Peninsula booth formed by one wall, open on three sides.
See the benefits you gain by choosing the Multiframe mobile trade booth. Impressive brand business card One of the most important features that distinguish the Multiframe modular trade booths is the elegant appearance of the construction. The trade booth setups presented here, combined with textile prints, attract attention from a distance. A modern trade booth of this type will become a business card for the brand, emphasizing the professional character of your company. Booth modification capability A particular feature of the Multiframe system is the ability to change the layout of the ordered system. The kits consist of aluminum profiles, which are connected using special connectors. If your needs for the booth layout change over time, you can easily transform the module arrangement into an entirely different construction. This is where the system's name comes from - based on Multiframe frames, you can create a multifunctional, portable exhibition stand. High-quality interchangeable prints The culmination of the aluminum construction in the Multiframe mobile trade booth are textile blockout material prints. This is a darkening fabric that does not let light through. Therefore, the system is not illuminated from the inside, but also light coming from other directions will not backlight the graphics. Importantly, our printing systems allow the preparation of really large prints, which then come in one piece for your construction. For example, we can print graphics measuring up to 10x2.5 m if necessary. For preparing prints for our mobile trade booths, we use sublimation printing technique. This eco-friendly method allows us to achieve high-quality graphics with deeply saturated colors. Thanks to this, our prints will excellently represent your graphic concept, and the booth will perfectly fit into the graphic identification system of the brand. Importantly, with possible changes to the booth layout or a change in promotional idea, you can order only the prints from us. The Multiframe construction is reusable, and you just need to order new graphics for the system. Mobile trade booth that folds down to compact sizes The Multiframe system has earned the designation "mobile" because, after the disassembly of aluminum frames, they are folded into handy bags, which you can even transport in a personal car. This means that when preparing to participate in trade shows, you don't need to rent a larger transport vehicle. Wide selection of accessories An important advantage of the mobile trade booths presented here is the wide offer of additional accessories. You can add lights, coverings, shelves, panels for hangers, lockable doors, and ceiling lights to the set. All this makes your trade booth construction an even more comfortable workplace and a better promotion carrier. Technical aspects:
Materials: aluminum, polyester, plastic cubes,
Module width: 50 or 100 cm,
Module height: 250/300/350 cm
Assembly: tool-free,
Dedicated bags included in the set
No internal LED lighting (possibility to purchase external lamps),
Accessories.

o.name: adFrame LPO 100x100 (bez wydruku)
o.desc:
How to best utilize the outdoor illuminated signboard?
Store sign: The coated material of the adFrame LPO is highly resistant to adverse weather conditions. As a result, this model can serve as a signboard placed in front of a store or service location.
Information board: Use the outdoor advertising box at a cultural institution to inform visitors about current temporary exhibitions or available performances. The information board can also be hung in the window of a hairdressing or beauty salon.
Entrance signage: Illuminated signs can be used at the entrance to an office or hotel reception. This ensures that your clients can easily find the right place.
adFrame LPO outdoor advertising box – advantages Innovative outdoor advertising The adFrame LPO model is the first illuminated signboard specifically designed for outdoor advertising. It is made from durable coated materials that are highly resistant to adverse weather conditions such as rain and strong wind. The LED lights are additionally protected by a silicone cover. This ensures that your outdoor advertisement will always be illuminated and ready to attract the attention of customers coming from afar. Durable and intuitive construction The adFrame LPO outdoor advertising signboard is mounted on an aluminum frame. Its assembly is completely tool-free and can be carried out by one person in a few minutes. The individual elements have appropriately marked connectors. The set includes glue and hooks for hanging and attaching the box. Interchangeable prints The illuminated signboard is equipped with a print on textile material edged with an elastic band. This print can be removed from the structure and replaced with another at any time, for example, one designed to promote a new event. This means that one structure can serve you for a long time, even if you change your company's visual identity. The outdoor advertising box is a reusable system and a long-term investment. Technical aspects:
single-sided hanging system,
aluminum frame with a width of 8 cm,
LED edge lighting protected by silicone,
print on textile material edged with an elastic band,
coated material adapted to weather conditions,
plug designed for outdoor use,
interchangeable prints,
tool-free assembly,
hooks and glue for mounting included in the set.
Dimensions:
Width: 100 cm
Height: 100/200/293 cm

o.name: Namiot pneumatyczny adTent V 4x4
o.desc:
Why Choose the adTent V Tent? The adTent V commercial tents by adsystem are perfect for promoting your brand. With customizable options for your company’s logo and colors, the tent helps highlight your stand and draw in customers. Discover the advantages of choosing our adTent V tent. Unique and Attractive Design This commercial tent features a structure open on three sides, designed to showcase and expose the stand's content rather than just offering protection. Visible from afar, the tent invites the public to enter and explore what’s on display. Additionally, the tent's roof provides protection from the sun and UV rays, ensuring greater comfort during outdoor events. Ease of Use and Handling The adTent V commercial tents are known for their ease of assembly. Simply connect an air pump to inflate the structure – quick and easy, with no additional tools required. Dismantling is just as convenient, allowing for rapid stand preparation even without prior assembly experience. Moreover, the stable pressure structure means it doesn’t need to stay connected to a compressor after inflation. Customizable Printing with Logo and Brand Design The modern design of the tent can be enhanced with personalized prints to promote your brand. We use waterproof polyester fabric that does not absorb moisture, protecting the stand in case of rain. Reusable and Durable System At adsystem, we focus on product durability and reusability. With proper maintenance, the adTent V commercial tents remain in excellent condition. If the fabric gets dirty, it can be easily cleaned with a damp cloth. Where to Use the adTent V Commercial Tent? Outdoor EventsFestivals, concerts, and sports events are ideal settings for the adTent V tent. In addition to providing sun protection, the open structure allows good air circulation, ensuring comfort under the roof. These tents are also great for beach events, beach bars, and sports competitions. Indoor PromotionsFor promotional activities in shopping centers and galleries, our commercial tents work perfectly as indoor stands. They are often used in the automotive sector to highlight new car or motorcycle models. In indoor events, the adTent V tents help organize the space, highlighting important areas such as food zones or information points. Technical Specifications:
Height: 400 cm
Width: 400 cm

o.desc: How can you use the adTribune Pop-up advertising counter? Our self-deploying adTribune Pop-up advertising stand will support your promotional activities during various events. You can use it as a portable promotional station during events in shopping malls, during trade fairs, or various promotions. It is also suitable for use in offices, receptions, or service salons. What are the benefits of the self-deploying advertising stand? A distinctive feature of the pop-up stand is its quick and tool-free assembly. We have implemented a design that allows for the product to be deployed with a single pull, without the need to fit and mount individual elements. As a result, the assembly of the stand will be efficient and fast, even if you lack manual skills. Moreover, the quickly deployable adTribune Pop-up exhibition counter for trade fairs is equipped with LED lighting installed on the side of the frame. Once the LEDs are turned on, the print with your graphics will become even more visible, and your promotional booth will attract customers' attention. In the printing process, we use the sublimation printing technique. This ensures that colors and graphics are vivid and vibrant, and the overall print is very effective. As a result, our self-deploying advertising stand will become an elegant business card for your company. The portable adTribune Pop-up promotional station is a reusable product. The stand is made of aluminum and plastic, making it durable. Importantly, if the graphic identification system of your company changes over time, or you prepare new graphics, you can still use the originally purchased stand. In such a case, you only need to purchase a new print for it.

In the printing process, we use the sublimation printing technique. This ensures that colors and graphics are vivid and vibrant, and the overall print is very effective. As a result, our self-deploying advertising stand will become an elegant business card for your company. The portable adTribune Pop-up promotional station is a reusable product. Where to use the self-assembling counter?
Trade fairs: set up the counter in seconds and attract attention with LED lighting. Keep customers engaged longer by offering wireless charging.

Product showcases: draw attention to your offerings with striking lighting and easy usability.
VIP zones: offer exclusive amenities and impress your guests.

Quick setup Forget complicated assembly. The pop-up counter unfolds with a single pull. No tools, no need to match individual parts. This saves you time and energy, making your promotional counter ready for use in just a few minutes. To start charging, just place a phone on the countertop. No cables mean convenience and simplicity of use. Customers approach to charge their devices, creating opportunities for conversations and showcasing your offerings. The convenience of charging keeps them around longer, giving you more time to build relationships. This simple feature creates a positive experience and fosters greater audience engagement.

o.name: adTent EXPRESS PRO 3x6m (konstrukcja+wydruk dach)
o.desc: adTent Express Pro Express Tent - Why Choose It? Express constructions are the most popular type of trade tents. This is due to their easy assembly and user-friendly operation. However, our express tents also stand out with other features that affect their functionality. See what benefits using the tent you are currently viewing brings. New, even stronger construction The adTent Express Pro express tent features a reinforced construction capable of supporting loads of up to 100 kilograms. This not only translates into overall stability and safety of use but also allows for additional exposure of products, as you can hang them, for example, under the tent's canopy. Attract customers to your booth adsystem advertising tents serve not only to provide you with a comfortable workspace. Our products will also catch the eye of passersby and draw their attention to your offer. To achieve this effect, we will cover the tent's walls, doors, and roof with prints featuring your personalized graphics. This will enable effective promotion and a clear advertising message. Effective protection against sun, wind, and rain The adTent Express Pro commercial tent will provide you with protection against adverse weather conditions. Importantly, the fabric on which we place your prints is waterproof. This will give you effective protection against rain, and water will not damage your promotional materials or other items stored under the tent. Quick, tool-free assembly Setting up and folding the tent is very easy, and even a person with no experience in manual work can handle this task. This is thanks to the special construction of the tent's roof, consisting of aluminum frames connected to each other. To set up the express tent, simply pull the tent's legs, spreading them in the intended directions. As a result, the frame will unfold automatically. There is no need to use any tools during assembly and disassembly. Therefore, transporting additional tool containers will not be a concern. Furthermore, the tent can be easily transported. We provide a wheeled carrying bag with the set, so moving to the promotion location will not be a problem. Prints with your personalized graphics We will complement the express tent with prints featuring your personalized graphics. You can include your company's graphics and logo or slogans encouraging customers to take advantage of your offer. Importantly, in our store, you can also purchase only a new fabric for the construction. Therefore, if you decide to conduct slightly different activities over time, just order new prints. As a result, our pavilion will be a tool for multiple uses. You should know that we use an ecological sublimation method to prepare prints. This solution guarantees the durability of the graphics and vivid colors. Therefore, our advertising tents will be a great showcase for your brand. We will adjust prints, walls, and tent doors to your needs. Various tent configurations are available in our store, so you can choose only some tent walls or opt for a version without them. By purchasing an adsytem product, you will surely choose a solution that meets your requirements. Where and When Can You Use the adTent Express Pro Express Tent? Express tents for concerts and festivals Express tents of this type are great for concerts, festivals, and other outdoor events. Such a tent can protect a gastronomic area, an information point, a registration place for participants in a sports event, etc. Set up outdoors, the tent will attract the attention of event participants and allow for effective use of available space. The advertising tent will also be a good choice for events in gardens, parks, or on beaches. Express tent for indoor use Our adTent Express Pro express tents will serve not only outside buildings. They can also be used as pavilions during fairs, markets, or promotions held in halls and galleries. In such a case, the advertising tent provides a sense of comfort in a larger space and helps delineate the boundaries of your promotional booth.

o.name: adWall Vario Classic 100 double sided (rollup)
o.desc:
Vario Classic 100 Advertising Walls - Why Choose Them? Exhibition walls of this type are effective communication tools. Thanks to them, potential customers will notice your brand, you will stand out from the crowd, and showcase your assortment. A wall with a print of your company's graphics will be an important support for your business. See what benefits such advertising walls offer. Easy assembly and convenient portability Advertising walls of this type are very easy to use. To assemble them, simply connect the pipes with special snaps. Moreover, the entire structure is made of aluminum, making it lightweight. As a result, transporting the advertising wall during promotions outside your company's headquarters will not be troublesome. Effective printing on two sides or one At adsytem, we strive to meet the needs of your advertising. Therefore, you can order the Vario Classic 100 wall with printing on one or two sides. This will allow you to maximize the promotional opportunities of the wall if your booth will be visible in a broader perspective or order a budget solution if the wall will only be visible from the front. Possibility of washing the fabric and changing the print Our textile walls are designed for long-term use. This is ensured not only by a solid construction but also by printing on material that can be machine washed at 30 degrees. As a result, the wall will serve you in good condition for a long time. What's more, if you change your logo over time, prepare a new promotion, or present new products, you can order new graphics for the wall. In this case, we will provide you with a new print material that will fit the original construction. Distinctive arc-vertical construction What distinguishes the advertising walls presented here is the unusual arc-vertical construction. Thanks to it, the print on the walls reaches from the floor to the top of the structure. As a result, items located behind the wall remain invisible. As a result, your booth at trade shows will stand out against the background of the entire environment, which will translate into improving brand presentation. Vario Classic 100 Advertising Wall - Where to Use Such a Wall? The textile wall you are currently viewing is a versatile product that will find its use in many promotional activities. Here are a few of our proposals for practical use of the Vario Classic 100 wall. Advertising wall for small booths The Vario Classic 100 advertising wall will be a good choice if you want to arrange a promotional booth at a trade show but have limited space. The product is 100 cm wide, so it takes up little space. At the same time, it is high enough to attract the attention of customers from a distance. Mobile advertising wall Advertising walls of this type will also be a good solution if you are looking for a truly mobile way to set up a promotional stand. The aluminum construction allows for quick and efficient folding and unfolding of the entire structure. So, if you often change the location of promoting products or services, the Vario Classic 100 advertising wall will work very well. Advertising wall for industry meetings If you organize a conference or a meeting of specialists in your industry, an advertising wall will help you prepare the room for the event. A wall with printing consistent with the visual identification of the organizer or conference will help participants orient themselves quickly, for example, in which room the lecture is taking place. In this case, with the help of such products, you can inform participants about. Advertising walls for service premises If you run a business in premises frequently visited by customers, textile walls can also be useful to you. With their help, you will showcase recommended products, inform customers about promotional actions and special events. Importantly, the ability to present various prints on the wall and exchange fabric will allow you to use various occasional events in promoting your brand. Moreover, it is worth noting that Vario Classic 100 advertising walls have a smaller width than our other products of this type. Thanks to this, textile walls do not take up much space, which is particularly important in small premises. Technical aspects:
lightweight aluminum construction with a 30mm profile cross-section, construction elements connected with snaps, print is fastened at the bottom with a zipper, feet at the bottom of the construction ensure its stability, certified, fire-resistant print (B1), gloves and foil included in the set, protecting against dirt during assembly.
Dimensions:
width: 100 cm, height: 230 cm, depth: 50 cm weight: 8 kg.

o.name: SET1 - Premium Chill Zone
o.desc:
The Premium Chill Zone set includes:
An adTent Air Premium inflatable advertising tent with dimensions of 5x5 m, will provide protection against adverse weather conditions and allow for effective brand exposure. The tent's structure is based on four inflatable, constant-pressure supports. You don't need to use any tools to erect the tent - just attach the prints with zippers and inflate the supports. The valves maintain constant pressure, so the air does not escape from the balloons, and the structure stands stably. The finishing touch is a roof and walls made of impregnated fabric, on which we will place your personalized graphics.
An adFlag Standard Pro advertising flag - an outdoor advertising medium that will attract recipients to your stand from afar. The flag is made of durable materials - the mast is prepared from damage-resistant, yet flexible fiberglass. This makes the product work great even in gusty winds. The fabric on which we will print your graphics is resistant to sun, wind, and rain.
4 adDeck advertising loungers - products whose structure is made of hard beech wood and waterproof, polyester fabric. The corporate loungers will provide visitors to your stand with a comfortable resting place - the seat has a three-level backrest height adjustment, and the material is pleasant to the touch. Personalized graphics will, in turn, be another medium of outdoor advertising and strengthen your promotional message.
Two adFoam Cube printed advertising poufs - outdoor furniture that will make your outdoor relaxation area even more functional. The poufs can serve as a comfortable seat or a side table that you set up next to the loungers. Our printed advertising poufs are filled with polyurethane foam, which is not only resistant to deformation but also lightweight - one pouf weighs only 2.5 kg. The dimensions of the pouffes are: 45x45x45 cm.
What benefits does the outdoor advertising product set provide?
Easier shopping and a more favorable price.
Free shipping.
Effective exposure and brand promotion.
Event and promotion location branding.
Protection against adverse weather conditions.
Where and under what circumstances will the Premium Chill Zone outdoor advertising set be useful to you?
Concerts and festivals,
promotional events,
corporate events,
family picnics,
beach bars.

o.name: SET2 - Economy Set
o.desc:
The set of outdoor advertising carriers includes the following products:
adTent Express pop-up tent in the size of 3x3 m, which will protect you from the sun and rain and will attract the attention of recipients. The advertising tent included in the set is based on an aluminum construction, which allows for a very quick setup. The tent is topped with a textile roof, on which we will place your personalized graphics. Importantly, the fabric used in the production of the tent is impregnated, which means it does not let moisture through. Dimensions of the tent: 300x300x340 cm.
3 adDeck loungers - event furniture that will not only provide you with comfortable seating but also strengthen your advertising message. The loungers are equipped with a solid, impregnated polyester fabric. It is on this fabric that we will place your logo or corporate graphics. Meanwhile, the structure of the loungers is made of hard beech wood, which provides solid support for the seat, capable of holding a load of up to 120 kg. The whole creates a comfortable seat with a three-step backrest height adjustment.
adFlag Standard XL advertising flag with which you will additionally mark your stand and attract the attention of recipients. The XL size advertising flag included in the set is 520 cm high. Thanks to this, your personalized graphics placed on the print will be visible from afar. Dimensions of the flag: 93 x 520 cm. Included in the set is a rotator and a 12 kg weight.
What are the benefits of the Economy Set of outdoor advertising carriers?
The price of the products gathered in the set is lower than when ordered separately.
The shipping of the complete set is free.
Effective advertising message and brand promotion.
Efficient event marking and making it easier for participants to navigate the area.
Protection from the sun and rain.
A comfortable resting place or meeting spot with clients during the event.
Where and under what circumstances will the Economy Set of outdoor advertising be useful to you?
Occasional use at concerts and festivals,
Outdoor promotions.
Corporate events

o.name: SET3 - Heavy-Duty Set
o.desc:
The Heavy Duty Set of outdoor advertising carriers includes:
adTent Express Pro 3x3 advertising tent - a product that will meet many outdoor challenges because it features a reinforced construction. As a result, it will perform well even in difficult weather conditions and strong wind. This is also a product you can rely on if you plan frequent use in environments such as construction, machinery, or agricultural fairs.
Importantly, the tent's reinforced construction provides not only resistance to wind but also additional product exposure - the frame can support a load of up to 100 kilograms, so under the canopy, you can hang your products or other advertising elements. The material on which we will place your graphics is impregnated, so it does not let moisture through. Additionally, the adTent Express Pro advertising tent is characterized by quick deployment.
2 adFlag Standard XL advertising flags will help you even better mark the event and show recipients the way to your booth. The flags have a height of 520 cm, so they will be visible from afar. Two bayonets and two transport bags are included in the set.
2 adFoam Cube advertising pouffes - are versatile outdoor furniture that can serve as seating or a side table. They are made of durable and deformation-resistant polyurethane foam and covered with moisture-resistant polyester fabric, on which we will place your company graphics. The dimensions of the pouffes are: 45x45x45 cm, and the weight of one is only 2.5kg.
4 adDeck advertising loungers - serve as both an advertising medium and comfortable seating. The loungers are made of solid beech wood construction and impregnated polyester fabric. Your corporate symbols will be printed on this fabric. The products also feature a three-step backrest height adjustment, and their maximum load is 120 kg.
What benefits does the Heavy Duty Set of outdoor advertising carriers offer?
The products in the set are cheaper than when ordered separately.
Shipping is free.
Effective advertising message.
Clear booth marking.
Durable materials.
Convenient assembly and transport.
Where and under what circumstances will the Heavy Duty SET of outdoor advertising be useful to you?
Regular use even in difficult weather conditions.
Festivals, concerts.
Fairs and promotions,
Corporate events

o.name: SET4 - Chill Zone
o.desc:
The Chill Zone set includes:
adTent Air Premium advertising tent, whose structure is based on four inflatable supports. Each of the balloons is covered with reinforced fabric, and thanks to special valves, the air does not escape from them. As a result, the structure maintains stability and does not need to be pumped up over time. The roof of the adTent Air Premium advertising tent is made of polyester fabric impregnated, which does not absorb moisture. It is on it that we will place your personalized graphics, thanks to which the tent will not only protect against the sun or rain but will also serve as an advertising medium.
adColumn Air advertising column is an element of outdoor advertising, with which you will attract the attention of recipients and mark your position. Compact trade show booth The Economic Vario set is designed for quickly setting up trade show booths. Thanks to the lightweight yet durable aluminum construction, the adWall Vario Straight Light wall and adTribune Seg counter allow for convenient and quick setup in any exhibition space. Due to its compact size, the set is ideal even in corridors or small trade show halls, where every square meter counts. Quick and tool-free assembly Tool-free assembly is one of the key advantages of the Economic Vario set. Both the wall and counter can be assembled in minutes, making this set perfect for events where time is of the essence. Professional advertising message The promotional materials on the wall and counter are made from high-quality polyester fabric. Graphics are applied using an eco-friendly sublimation printing technique, resulting in vivid, sharp colors that effectively capture the attention of your audience. Additionally, the Vario material is flexible and resistant to wrinkles, ensuring a professional appearance for your booth. Whats included in the set?
adWall Vario Straight Light wall 300 x 230 cm with double-sided print,

The combination of an illuminated visual message and functional presentation space provides everything you need to effectively showcase your brand during an event. SEGO lightbox 300 x 250 cm,
two SEGO lightboxes 100 x 250 cm,
adTribune SEGO counter 100 x 100 cm,
two SEGO shelves,
six SEGO internal connectors.

o.desc:
Applications:
Trade shows,
business conferences,
training sessions,
information points,
open days at company headquarters,
promotional events.
Why choose the Standard DTF trade show set? With its well-thought-out design and high-quality components, the Standard DTF set provides not only an aesthetic presentation but also the convenience and flexibility essential for dynamic events. Flexibility The trade show set consists of two fabric walls in different sizes – 300 x 250 cm and 200 x 250 cm. You can arrange them to fit the available space, creating an "L" shaped booth that can be open on either the right or left side. This flexibility allows for optimal space utilization while ensuring good brand visibility. Backlit counter With built-in LED lighting, promotional materials on the adTribune Expo counter are clearly visible and attract the attention of visitors. The solid construction and elegant design give the counter the appearance of luxury furniture, while the internal shelf allows for convenient storage of promotional materials and other necessary accessories. Simple assembly and mobility Both the adFrame DTF walls and the adTribune Expo counter are designed for ease of use. Tool-free assembly allows for quick booth setup, and all components of the set can be easily packed and transported in compact bags. This makes it an ideal solution for companies that frequently participate in various events and need mobile, flexible display systems. What’s included in the set?
adFrame DTF frame 300 x 250 cm,
adFrame DTF frame 200 x 250 cm,
adTribune Expo counter with LED lighting.

o.name: SET4 - Zestaw do promocji Economic Vario
o.product_type: Exhibition Booths for Events and Conferences > Advertising Spaces up to 5 m²
o.desc:
Applications:
Promotions in shopping malls,
product presentations,
information booths at events,
service locations,
tastings in stores and shopping galleries,
promotional events.
Why choose the Economic Vario promotional set? By choosing the Economic Vario promotional set, youre investing in a mobile, durable, and functional solution that will help you effectively promote your brand. A functional pair The tall adWall Vario Presto Light wall attracts attention from a distance, increasing the chances of catching the interest of passersby and potential customers. It also serves as an attractive backdrop for a presenter at the booth. Whether displaying a company logo or a product advertisement, high-quality prints help build a positive brand image. Meanwhile, the adTribune Quick counter provides a convenient space for product presentations or brochures. It can be set up in just a few seconds – the pneumatic system allows for raising it with a single smooth motion. Professional and cohesive booth The products included in the set are made from the same materials, with the graphic design printed on Vario polyester fabric. This combination of the wall and counter creates a harmonious exhibition space that grabs attention and enhances brand recognition. With the aesthetic matching of both elements, your booth will look cohesive and professional at any event. Compatibility and mobility The Economic Vario set is designed with small spaces and mobility in mind. Thanks to the compact dimensions of both products, you can create a fully functional promotional booth in a small area. Both the wall and the counter are lightweight, and when folded, they fit into convenient transport bags. This makes it easy to transport the entire set, even in a regular car. Whats included in the set?
adWall Vario Presto Light wall 90 x 230 cm with double-sided print,
adTribune Quick counter 90 x 70 x 40 cm.

o.name: SEGO Cubic Counter (without print)
o.desc:
Where is the conference podium best suited?
Conference speeches, trade shows, business presentations, product and promotional material displays, marketing campaigns, artistic exhibitions.
Advantages of the adTribune Cubic model With its sturdy construction, quick installation, and broad customization options, the adTribune Cubic offers a perfect solution for companies looking to present themselves professionally at trade shows, conferences, and other industry events. Square-shaped counter The adTribune Cubic stands out with its square shape, making it suitable as an elegant podium or display pedestal. The enclosed interior provides a secure place for storing promotional materials, while its unique design allows for creative use of the print space. Various print options You can fully customize the print on the adTribune Cubic to meet your promotional needs. We offer a single graphic surrounding the entire counter or four different designs placed on each side of the structure. No matter which option you choose, your graphic will be printed on high-quality polyester fabric. Additionally, you can order prints separately to update them with new campaigns. Quick and tool-free assembly The adTribune Cubic conference podium is designed for easy setup, requiring just two minutes to prepare it for use. The foldable tabletop makes transportation even more convenient, and the entire assembly process is tool-free. Despite its sturdy construction, the counter is lightweight and portable. Compatibility with trade show setups The adTribune Cubic podium fits seamlessly into comprehensive trade show setups. The blockout material used in its production is consistent with other display elements. The counter can serve as a pillar, post, or enclosed storage unit. Its solid form resembles trade show furniture, allowing it to blend perfectly with other booth components.

o.name: adFrame Lumina RGB 100x200cm (without print)
o.desc:
Where can you use the RGB LED lightbox?
Industry trade shows: Attract attention and stand out from other exhibitors with striking illumination and the dynamic RGB frame. Use programmed lighting to highlight specific sections of your booth.
Promotional and advertising events: Emphasize your marketing message and create a memorable atmosphere for attendees.
Product campaigns: Draw attention to a new product or special offer in a crowded environment.
Entertainment venues: Enhance spaces with colorful backlighting that gives the location a unique character.
Business conferences: Highlight professionalism and innovation by presenting your company’s values in a modern way.
Fashion shows: Create an elegant visual setting that perfectly complements the showcased collection.
Key features of adFrame Lumina RGB Lumina RGB addresses the need to go beyond traditional advertising forms, bringing a new level of quality and energy to where classic roll-ups once dominated. It replaces static displays with a dynamic play of light and color. Lumina RGB is not just a lightbox but a symbol of advertising’s future – futuristic, eye-catching, and unforgettable. Change the frame colors as needed, adapting them to the occasion and the brand's style. Create complex compositions by combining several lightboxes into one cohesive trade show booth. Surprise audiences with dual backlighting and shine above the competition. Unique RGB LED panel Lumina RGB is the only lightbox on the market with a design that incorporates two illuminated elements: LED print and an RGB frame. The RGB panel can glow in a solid color or shift through various hues, depending on your chosen settings with the included remote. Adapt the dynamic lighting to your message and brand’s identity to create a “wow” effect and draw attention at trade shows, events, and other gatherings. Versatile construction With Lumina RGB, you can create an attractive booth tailored to any space. The lightboxes in this series can be connected at 90 or 180 degrees to form corners or more complex layouts, using additional connectors. Accessories such as leaflet holders and TV mounts offer even more flexibility in booth planning. Enhance the functionality of your advertising with the possibilities offered by Lumina RGB. Interchangeable graphics tailored to your brand The Lumina RGB lightbox allows for regular content updates, making it easy to adapt to specific events or campaigns. The material used for graphics is edged with a silicone gasket. To refresh your message, simply install a new graphic by sliding the gasket into the frame’s groove. The high-quality fabric ensures excellent print clarity, with colors appearing vibrant and professional. Lumina RGB gives you complete control over your brand’s image, enabling you to adapt your message to any situation.

Entertainment venues: Enhance spaces with colorful backlighting that gives the location a unique character.
Business conferences: Highlight professionalism and innovation by presenting your company’s values in a modern way.
Fashion shows: Create an elegant visual setting that perfectly complements the showcased collection.
Key features of adFrame Lumina RGB Lumina RGB addresses the need to go beyond traditional advertising forms, bringing a new level of quality and energy to where classic roll-ups once dominated. It replaces static displays with a dynamic play of light and color. Lumina RGB is not just a lightbox but a symbol of advertising’s future – futuristic, eye-catching, and unforgettable. Change the frame colors as needed, adapting them to the occasion and the brand's style. Create complex compositions by combining several lightboxes into one cohesive trade show booth. Surprise audiences with dual backlighting and shine above the competition. Unique RGB LED panel Lumina RGB is the only lightbox on the market with a design that incorporates two illuminated elements: LED print and an RGB frame. The RGB panel can glow in a solid color or shift through various hues, depending on your chosen settings with the included remote. Adapt the dynamic lighting to your message and brand’s identity to create a “wow” effect and draw attention at trade shows, events, and other gatherings. Versatile construction With Lumina RGB, you can create an attractive booth tailored to any space. The lightboxes in this series can be connected at 90 or 180 degrees to form corners or more complex layouts, using additional connectors. Accessories such as leaflet holders and TV mounts offer even more flexibility in booth planning. Enhance the functionality of your advertising with the possibilities offered by Lumina RGB. Interchangeable graphics tailored to your brand The Lumina RGB lightbox allows for regular content updates, making it easy to adapt to specific events or campaigns. The material used for graphics is edged with a silicone gasket. To refresh your message, simply install a new graphic by sliding the gasket into the frame’s groove. The high-quality fabric ensures excellent print clarity, with colors appearing vibrant and professional. Lumina RGB gives you complete control over your brand’s image, enabling you to adapt your message to any situation.

Advantages of the Inflatable Counter adTribune Air Constant Pressure Structure The adTribune Air inflatable counter uses a constant pressure structure that does not require continuous connection to an air compressor after the initial inflation. This makes it extremely practical, saving energy and maintaining an ideal level of pressure throughout the event. The structure is equipped with a safety valve that maintains an optimal pressure level throughout its entire use. This ensures the product remains reliable during its entire lifespan. Weather-Resistant Prints The prints on the adTribune Air are made from waterproof polyester fabric, providing protection against rain and UV rays. This keeps your graphics sharp and vibrant, even in challenging weather. Additionally, the option to replace the prints allows the counter to be quickly and easily adapted to different promotional campaigns. Tool-Free Assembly The inflatable counter is simple and intuitive to assemble. Just inflate the structure to create a stable, ready-to-use promotional counter. Disassembly is equally quick, allowing the counter to be stored in the included carrying bag, making it easy to transport and store. What’s Included in the Set?

o.name: LuminaStick
o.desc:
Where to use RGB Stick?
Exhibition halls: Present brochures and promotional folders in a way that captures the attention of clients and business partners.
Retail stores and showrooms: Display small products like shoes, cosmetics, or accessories.
Libraries and educational spaces: Illuminate shelves with brochures or new book releases, encouraging readers to explore.
Reception areas and offices: Highlight key information such as schedules, informational brochures, or branding materials.
Promotional events and product campaigns: Combine Lumina Stick with other elements of the Lumina series to create larger, attention-grabbing displays.
Entertainment venues: Light up brochures and gadgets, creating a unique ambiance in clubs, bars, and cinemas.
Cultural events: Use Lumina Stick to enrich promotional spaces during festivals or premieres.
Key features The Lumina Stick enhances any exhibition space. Its modular construction and dynamic RGB LED lighting adapt to various needs, facilitating personalization and creating eye-catching displays. RGB LED lighting controlled by remote The Lumina Stick is the first brochure stand on the market equipped with RGB LED lighting. The remote control included in the set allows quick adjustments to colors and light intensity, tailoring them to different occasions and brand visual identities. The Lumina Stick runs on batteries, eliminating the need for a power connection. Its 8-hour battery life ensures extended use, and fast charging keeps the product ready for action. It’s a solution that brings any space to life. Modular construction and versatility The modular design of the Lumina Stick allows for easy customization. Shelves can be attached in various configurations and shapes – offering both classic brochure holders and round shelves for product displays. This flexibility enables the product to serve multiple roles: brochure stand, display, or standalone light stick. Assembly and disassembly are quick and tool-free, saving time during setup. Additional branding space A narrow print with custom graphics can be mounted on the Lumina Stick’s structure. This feature enriches the display with a logo, slogan, or image to reinforce branding messages. The print seamlessly integrates with the structure without limiting its functionality. Compatibility with the Lumina series The Lumina Stick can be combined with other products from the Lumina series, creating cohesive and expansive lighting displays. As a result, it becomes an excellent addition to trade show booths and event spaces.

o.name: Pop-up COMBO Counter Lightbox 100x100 incl. charging
o.desc:
Where can you use Pop-up Combo?
Trade shows and exhibitions – perfect for events where professional appearance and quick installation are crucial.
Conferences and presentations – serves as a backdrop for presentations and a space for engaging with participants.
Promotions in shopping malls – grabs customers’ attention with illuminated graphics and a functional counter.
Tasting and promotional zones – allows for a convenient display of products and promotional materials.
Why choose Pop-up Combo? Cohesive design The pop-up lightbox and counter create a stylish, unified solution that enhances brand recognition and attracts visitors. Quick tool-free assembly Both components of the set are designed for fast and intuitive assembly, saving you time during setup. The structures are based on a modern pop-up system, requiring only a simple upward motion to erect the display. High visibility with LED illumination Illuminated graphics on the pop-up lightbox and counter ensure excellent visibility of your advertisement, even from a distance, drawing potential customers to your booth. Cost-effective solution By purchasing the lightbox and counter as a set, you save more compared to buying them separately – a budget-friendly option for your business. Mobility and convenience Both elements are lightweight and easy to transport. The set includes practical transport bags for effortless portability. Counter with or without a charger Customize your Pop-up Combo with a counter that features a built-in wireless charger for convenient device charging or choose the version without it. What’s included in the set?
Pop-up lightbox with graphic print
Pop-up counter with graphic print
Transport bags for each component
